title: NEW! 20 mins to Nashville with boat dock!
description:
Perfect for a couples getaway! Bring your boat! Steeped in local tradition, this stylish space beckons you to kick back, relax and have fun! Only 20 minutes to Nashville. Enjoy our paddle boards, canoe or kayaks and a beautiful sunset on 96 mile Old Hickory Lake and even a boat slip! Walking distance to Anchor High Marina and the Rudder Bar and Grill waterfront. There are several other marinas with restaurants and boat rentals here on Old Hickory Lake! Experience, Nashville, like the locals!

The space
Gorgeous property with mature trees, and lake access. Great king size, 1 bedroom apartment with shared deck, dock with slip, paddle boards, and kayaks, and huge back yard on 96 mile Old Hickory Lake and only 20 minutes to Nashville

Guest access
Full, private lower level guest apartment and shared deck plus huge shared back yard and boat dock with paddle boards, kayaks, and a canoe. Chairs and, weather permitting, fire pit and gas grill. We also have some outdoor Lawn games like cornhole and a hook and loop game.
